searchText: Hi, do you know where in the code I can find when are rewards and penalties taken into account? Like, if my attestation is included in a block and I am rewarded for it, when is my stake updated? Look in https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/altair/beacon-chain.md#rewards-and-penalties <@357182713440239623>
